short_description: Outbound dial requests stall during contact campaign bursts
description: Contact flows entered the outbound branch, but calls were not placed when scheduled campaign traffic overlapped. Lambda logs showed throttled invocations and later retries often completed.
close_notes: Restored outbound capacity and added an alarm for concurrency headroom.
root_cause: Reserved concurrency for the outbound orchestration Lambda was lower than the peak contact-flow burst, so valid invocations were throttled before the outbound API call.
resolution: Raised reserved concurrency to the tested campaign ceiling, enabled provisioned concurrency for the launch window, and added throttling and queue-depth alarms.

short_description: Campaign contacts remain pending after dialer release
description: The flow and function completed, while the outbound contact request intermittently exceeded its client deadline. The behavior began with a release that reduced downstream timeouts.
close_notes: Corrected the release configuration and verified repeated outbound call creation.
root_cause: A deployment set the outbound contact API client timeout below normal service latency and disabled the previous bounded retry policy.
resolution: Restored the validated client timeout, enabled exponential retry for transient timeouts, and added a release test that confirms contact creation rather than Lambda completion alone.

short_description: Amazon Connect outbound calls fail after Lambda deployment
description: The contact flow starts successfully and the Lambda invocation completes, but no outbound call is established. CloudWatch shows intermittent timeout errors, manual retry sometimes succeeds, and the issue began immediately after deployment.

short_description: Transferred callers disconnect before reaching specialist queue
description: Calls remained stable with the first agent, then ended immediately when the transfer-to-queue block executed. The target queue showed no new contacts.
close_notes: Repointed the transfer block and validated warm and cold transfers.
root_cause: The published contact flow referenced a retired queue after the specialist queues were renamed, leaving the transfer block with an invalid destination.
resolution: Updated the flow to the current queue, republished it, and added automated validation that every transfer destination exists and is enabled.

short_description: Warm transfers lose media after agent handoff
description: The destination agent accepted the contact, but both parties heard silence and the contact terminated moments later. Direct inbound calls were unaffected.
close_notes: Removed the obsolete media branch and confirmed transfer audio continuity.
root_cause: A legacy transfer branch stopped media streaming before the destination agent was joined, causing the contact to lose its media path during handoff.
resolution: Moved media shutdown after successful handoff, republished the contact flow, and added a transfer audio check to the release suite.

short_description: Customer calls end when agents transfer to billing
description: Inbound conversations are normal until an agent selects the billing transfer. The destination agent is briefly offered the contact, then the call disconnects before audio is established.

short_description: Order event processor reaches timeout during retry storms
description: Function duration climbed to its maximum while concurrent executions remained saturated. Duplicate downstream retries kept workers occupied and delayed fresh order events.
close_notes: Stopped the retry amplification and restored concurrency headroom.
root_cause: Synchronous retries lacked jitter and held Lambda environments until timeout, exhausting reserved concurrency and amplifying the backlog.
resolution: Replaced inline retries with bounded asynchronous retry, added jitter and idempotency, and alarmed on concurrent execution saturation.

short_description: Webhook Lambda throttles despite low average traffic
description: Short bursts produced throttles and API errors although the hourly request rate looked normal. Concurrency graphs reached a flat ceiling during each burst.
close_notes: Adjusted concurrency allocation and verified burst processing under load.
root_cause: A newly deployed function consumed the regional unreserved concurrency pool, leaving the webhook dispatcher without capacity during bursts.
resolution: Assigned reserved concurrency to both critical functions, capped the batch worker, and introduced a pre-deployment concurrency budget check.

short_description: Invoice worker times out as event backlog grows
description: Invoice events remain visible for repeated processing, function duration approaches the configured limit, and concurrent executions stay at capacity during the morning batch.

short_description: Recommendation requests receive bursts of model throttling
description: Embedding calls succeeded, but generation returned intermittent throttling during parallel investigations. Retrying after traffic subsided usually worked.
close_notes: Smoothed generation traffic and verified controlled retries under load.
root_cause: The investigation worker launched unbounded parallel generation calls and exceeded the model's available on-demand throughput.
resolution: Added a concurrency limiter, exponential backoff with jitter for throttling, and metrics separating embedding from generation failures.

short_description: Grounded analysis intermittently returns dependency errors
description: Vector retrieval completed consistently, while some recommendation calls failed before producing text. A second request often succeeded without data changes.
close_notes: Aligned client timeouts with the function budget and added safe transient retry.
root_cause: The Bedrock client read timeout was shorter than observed generation latency and transient service errors were not retried.
resolution: Set the client timeout within the Lambda execution budget, added one bounded retry for retryable errors, and published latency percentile alarms.

short_description: Incident recommendations fail intermittently under demo load
description: Similarity search completes, but occasional generation requests return a dependency error. Repeating the analysis later can return a normal recommendation.

short_description: Deployment workflow cannot assume AWS release role
description: Build and tests passed, but the deployment job failed at credential exchange. The workflow had recently moved to a reusable GitHub Actions definition.
close_notes: Corrected the federation conditions and completed a controlled deployment.
root_cause: The role trust policy required an audience claim that differed from the claim configured by the reusable workflow's OIDC request.
resolution: Aligned the OIDC audience and subject conditions, restricted them to the deployment branch, and added a preflight role-assumption job.

short_description: SAM release job packages an outdated Lambda artifact
description: The workflow reported success, yet the deployed function did not contain the latest handler change. The package checksum matched an earlier build.
close_notes: Separated dependency caching from build output and verified artifact provenance.
root_cause: The pipeline restored the generated SAM build directory from a broad cache key and deployed that stale artifact without rebuilding source.
resolution: Excluded generated build output from caches, required a fresh SAM build, and recorded the source commit and artifact digest in deployment metadata.

short_description: Main branch deployment fails after tests complete
description: The GitHub Actions workflow passes lint and unit tests, then fails during the release stage before CloudFormation begins updating the development stack.

short_description: Contact automation loses permission to start outbound calls
description: The Lambda function ran normally but every outbound contact request was denied after an execution-role cleanup. Contact flows continued to enter the integration branch.
close_notes: Restored the narrow Connect action and added an authorization canary.
root_cause: A role-policy refactor removed the specific Amazon Connect outbound contact action required by the orchestration Lambda.
resolution: Added the missing action for only the development Connect instance and introduced a deployment test that performs a non-customer synthetic authorization check.

short_description: Lambda cannot read integration credential after key rotation
description: Cold starts failed while loading the managed integration credential, while warm environments continued briefly. Secrets Manager access checks reported a decrypt denial.
close_notes: Corrected decrypt authorization and verified cold-start credential loading.
root_cause: The replacement encryption key policy did not include the Lambda execution role, so Secrets Manager could retrieve metadata but could not decrypt the secret value.
resolution: Granted the execution role decrypt permission only through Secrets Manager for the development secret and added a cold-start validation after rotations.

short_description: Incident API reports access denied while loading MCP credential
description: Health remains available, but data requests fail when a fresh Lambda environment attempts to load the managed repository credential from Secrets Manager.

short_description: Voicebot forgets verified intent between dialog turns
description: Callers completed verification, but the next utterance restarted the welcome prompt. Session traces showed the prior intent disappearing after a pause.
close_notes: Extended session retention and confirmed intent continuity across pauses.
root_cause: The session store expiration was shorter than the contact flow's allowed caller response window, deleting context before the next turn.
resolution: Aligned session expiration with the maximum conversation duration, refreshed it on each turn, and added a pause-duration regression test.

short_description: Returning callers are sent back to voicebot greeting
description: The bot recognized speech but could not recover the conversation state after a blue-green release. New sessions behaved correctly while sessions started before the release restarted.
close_notes: Restored compatible session lookup and completed cross-version dialog tests.
root_cause: The new release changed the session-key prefix without a compatibility read path, making in-progress context invisible to the new Lambda version.
resolution: Restored the stable prefix, added dual-read migration logic for existing sessions, and added blue-green continuity tests.

short_description: Voicebot repeats welcome prompt after collecting account intent
description: The caller selects an intent and hears the correct confirmation, but the following response returns to the initial greeting instead of continuing the dialog.

short_description: German callers route to default English support queue
description: Language detection returned German, but the routing flow used the default branch. Queue metrics showed unexpected German-language contacts in English support.
close_notes: Normalized language values and validated each supported routing branch.
root_cause: The detector emitted lowercase locale values while the contact flow compared uppercase values, so no localized branch matched.
resolution: Normalized locale attributes before routing, added an explicit fallback reason, and tested all supported locale variants.

short_description: Spanish voice contacts wait in the wrong queue
description: Spanish prompts played correctly, yet callers entered the general queue and wait time increased. The localized queue remained nearly empty.
close_notes: Corrected the queue mapping and confirmed localized queue occupancy.
root_cause: A configuration promotion mapped the Spanish locale to the general queue identifier instead of the localized support queue.
resolution: Corrected the environment mapping, validated queue identifiers during deployment, and added routing metrics grouped by detected locale.

short_description: French callers hear localized prompt but reach general support
description: The language prompt is French and the detected locale is present, but contacts appear in the general support queue instead of the configured French queue.

short_description: Analyze UI action receives forbidden response from backend
description: The ServiceNow button was visible and constructed a request, but API Gateway rejected every call before Lambda invocation. Other scoped application features were unaffected.
close_notes: Re-entered the private API key property and verified a protected request.
root_cause: The private ServiceNow API-key property was empty after the scoped application was installed on a refreshed development instance.
resolution: Loaded the generated development key into the private password property, kept it out of update sets, and added a post-install configuration checklist.

short_description: ServiceNow analysis request targets a nonexistent API path
description: Outbound REST execution returned not found while health checks against the base API succeeded. The configured endpoint contained the stage path twice.
close_notes: Corrected the full endpoint property and confirmed response parsing.
root_cause: The endpoint property already included the API stage, while a local configuration procedure appended the same stage a second time.
resolution: Stored the complete analysis endpoint exactly once, removed path concatenation from the setup procedure, and added an endpoint-format validation check.

short_description: Analyze action times out without adding work notes
description: The incident form action waits until the outbound REST timeout and displays a safe failure message. No recommendation is written to work notes.

short_description: Checkout latency rises as database sessions reach pool limit
description: Application latency increased while database CPU remained moderate. Workers waited for a connection and pool acquisition timeouts appeared during traffic peaks.
close_notes: Bounded client concurrency and restored stable pool acquisition latency.
root_cause: Each worker created its own oversized connection pool, allowing aggregate demand to exceed the development database connection budget.
resolution: Reduced per-worker pool size, capped worker concurrency, reused initialized pools, and alerted on acquisition wait time and total sessions.

short_description: Outbound workflow intermittently waits for database connection
description: The contact flow invoked Lambda, but some calls timed out before the outbound request. Function traces showed most delay occurred while acquiring a VPC database connection, and retries often succeeded.
close_notes: Reused VPC database pools and verified outbound calls during concurrency tests.
root_cause: The deployed Lambda created a new VPC database pool for every invocation, saturating available connections and consuming the function timeout before the outbound contact API call.
resolution: Moved pool initialization outside the handler, reduced pool size, limited function concurrency, and added a connection-acquisition timeout shorter than the overall invocation budget.

short_description: Campaign state workers wait for connections during call launch
description: Outbound launch latency rises with concurrent campaign workers. Database acquisition waits appear before calls are requested, while a manual retry during lower traffic usually completes.

short_description: Outbound contacts are rejected for locally formatted destinations
description: The contact flow and orchestration function completed, but requests for one synthetic region failed before dialing. Validation logs identified destination formatting errors while E.164 test destinations succeeded.
close_notes: Normalized synthetic destinations and added format validation before contact submission.
root_cause: A release passed national destination strings to the outbound contact operation without converting them to the required E.164 format.
resolution: Introduced allowlisted country-code normalization, rejected ambiguous destinations before invocation, and added contract tests covering every supported synthetic locale.

short_description: Outbound contacts end before dial tone after flow promotion
description: Contact identifiers were returned successfully, but synthetic calls terminated before a carrier leg was created. The issue appeared only after the outbound flow configuration was promoted.
close_notes: Republished the reviewed outbound flow and validated carrier-leg creation.
root_cause: The environment promotion associated the campaign with a draft contact-flow version whose error branch disconnected contacts before the outbound dialing block.
resolution: Associated the campaign with the published flow version, added a deployment check that resolves flow state, and verified the full synthetic call lifecycle after promotion.

short_description: Campaign dial requests queue behind abandoned synthetic contacts
description: New outbound requests remained pending while Lambda duration and permissions were healthy. Connect metrics showed the concurrent outbound call allowance fully occupied by contacts that never reached cleanup.
close_notes: Released stranded contacts and restored outbound-capacity headroom.
root_cause: A campaign cancellation path did not stop contacts already submitted to Connect, leaving abandoned synthetic calls to consume the concurrent outbound contact allowance.
resolution: Added deterministic contact cleanup on cancellation, reconciled submitted contact IDs, and alarmed when pending contacts consume more than the reviewed capacity threshold.

short_description: Agents cannot transfer contacts to the escalation queue
description: The initial conversation remained stable, but the transfer control rejected the escalation target for every agent in one routing profile. Direct contacts to that queue continued to arrive.
close_notes: Restored queue access to the routing profile and verified warm transfers.
root_cause: A routing-profile update removed the escalation queue from the set of queues available to agents, so agent-initiated transfers were denied before handoff.
resolution: Reattached the queue to the reviewed routing profile, validated transfer permissions for each synthetic agent role, and added configuration-drift checks.

short_description: Transferred callers return to the original menu branch
description: The destination agent accepted the contact, but the next flow step replayed the original self-service menu instead of completing the specialist handoff. Transfer traces lacked the expected handover marker.
close_notes: Restored transfer metadata and confirmed specialist handoff completion.
root_cause: The transfer Lambda wrote the handover attribute under a renamed key while the destination contact-flow branch still evaluated the previous key.
resolution: Restored the stable attribute contract, added compatibility reads for in-flight contacts, and added branch tests for queue and agent transfers.

short_description: Quick-connect transfers fail for the newly created support team
description: Calls could transfer to established teams, but choosing the new support target returned an unavailable-destination message. Queue health and agent availability were normal.
close_notes: Assigned the quick connect to the intended queues and tested both directions.
root_cause: The new quick-connect resource existed but was not associated with the queues used by the source agents, so it could not be resolved during transfer.
resolution: Associated the quick connect with the reviewed source queues, introduced an association audit in deployment validation, and tested agent-to-queue handoffs.

short_description: Image-processing Lambda times out after dependency upgrade
description: Invocation memory stayed near its limit and duration rose sharply after a library upgrade. Downstream services remained responsive, but garbage collection dominated the final seconds of each invocation.
close_notes: Right-sized function memory and verified processing duration under representative load.
root_cause: The dependency upgrade increased the working set beyond the function's configured memory, causing repeated garbage collection and CPU starvation before timeout.
resolution: Raised memory to the measured operating point, removed an unused image codec, and added max-memory and duration regression gates to the release workflow.

short_description: Event Lambda exhausts outbound HTTP connections during bursts
description: Concurrent invocations accumulated while requests waited for a reusable downstream socket. The dependency responded normally to direct checks, and cold environments initially recovered.
close_notes: Closed leaked responses and restored stable socket reuse during bursts.
root_cause: An exception path returned before closing downstream HTTP response objects, gradually exhausting the warm environment's connection pool.
resolution: Wrapped responses in deterministic context cleanup, bounded the HTTP pool, added acquisition timeouts, and load-tested repeated failure paths.

short_description: Poison event monopolizes Lambda batch concurrency
description: One malformed event caused entire batches to return repeatedly, while healthy messages waited and concurrent executions stayed at the event-source maximum. Function code otherwise completed within its timeout.
close_notes: Isolated the malformed event and restored healthy batch throughput.
root_cause: Partial batch failure reporting was disabled, so one permanently invalid message forced every healthy record in its batch to retry and consume concurrency.
resolution: Enabled partial batch responses, routed terminal validation failures to a reviewed dead-letter path, and alarmed on repeated message receives.

short_description: Bedrock generation rejects requests after model configuration change
description: Embedding and retrieval completed, but every generation request returned validation failure before producing text. The errors started after the maximum output setting was raised.
close_notes: Restored a supported generation limit and added model-specific configuration checks.
root_cause: The deployment configured a maximum token count above the selected generation model's supported limit, making the otherwise valid Converse request fail validation.
resolution: Pinned a reviewed model-specific output limit, validated inference settings during startup, and added a contract test for the configured model identifier.

short_description: Recommendation generation fails only in the deployment region
description: The function loaded and embedding calls succeeded, but recommendation requests consistently failed in the development region. A configuration preview referenced a model not enabled there.
close_notes: Returned to the approved in-region model and verified grounded generation.
root_cause: An environment override selected a generation model identifier without on-demand availability in the deployed AWS region.
resolution: Restored the approved in-region model, added a pre-deployment availability check, and failed configuration validation when the region/model pair is not reviewed.

short_description: Synchronized retries prolong Bedrock throttling window
description: A brief generation throttle expanded into repeated waves of failures. Workers retried at the same intervals, and request volume spiked again before capacity recovered.
close_notes: Desynchronized retry traffic and restored stable generation throughput.
root_cause: All workers used the same fixed retry delay for throttled generation calls, creating synchronized retry waves that repeatedly exceeded available throughput.
resolution: Added bounded exponential backoff with full jitter, honored retry guidance, capped concurrent generation, and tested recovery from a synthetic throttle window.

short_description: GitHub deployment job cannot request an OIDC token
description: Checkout and tests passed, but AWS credential configuration reported that the workflow could not obtain an identity token. The repository role trust policy was unchanged.
close_notes: Restored the OIDC permission and completed role assumption without static keys.
root_cause: A workflow permissions cleanup removed id-token write access from the calling job, preventing GitHub from issuing the OIDC token required for role assumption.
resolution: Restored narrowly scoped id-token write permission, retained contents read access, and added a workflow test that verifies token availability before deployment steps.

short_description: Deployment job receives an empty artifact reference
description: The build job uploaded the expected package, but the downstream deployment job resolved an empty artifact name and stopped before creating a change set.
close_notes: Corrected the job output mapping and verified artifact provenance end to end.
root_cause: The reusable workflow mapped its job output to a retired step identifier, so the valid artifact name never crossed the job boundary.
resolution: Mapped the output to the current build step, asserted that required outputs are non-empty, and added a digest check before the deployment job consumes an artifact.

short_description: SAM change set fails after environment argument refactor
description: Build and package completed, but CloudFormation rejected the deployment because a required non-secret parameter was absent. The failure began after parameter assembly moved into a composite step.
close_notes: Restored required parameter forwarding and validated the generated change set.
root_cause: The composite action built parameter overrides from an incomplete allowlist and dropped the required CockroachDB database parameter before invoking SAM deploy.
resolution: Added the missing non-secret parameter to the reviewed allowlist, validated required names before deployment, and tested argument construction without exposing values.

short_description: Lambda loses secret access after development secret recreation
description: Cold starts began returning access denied while loading configuration immediately after the secret was recreated. The role policy still referenced the previous resource identifier.
close_notes: Aligned the scoped policy with the recreated development secret resource.
root_cause: The least-privilege role policy remained pinned to the previous secret resource suffix after recreation, so the new secret was outside the allowed resource scope.
resolution: Updated the reviewed infrastructure parameter to the new resource, deployed the scoped policy change, and added a post-recreation cold-start authorization check.

short_description: Managed MCP authentication fails after credential rotation
description: Secrets Manager retrieval succeeded and the secret was non-empty, but every newly initialized Managed MCP session was rejected. Warm invocations using the previous cached value continued temporarily.
close_notes: Restored the expected plaintext credential format and verified new MCP sessions.
root_cause: The rotation procedure stored a JSON wrapper in a secret consumed as a plaintext Managed MCP key, so authentication received serialized configuration instead of the key value.
resolution: Replaced the value with the reviewed plaintext format, added a shape-only validation that never logs the credential, and documented overlapping rotation for warm environments.

short_description: Runtime role is denied by copied secret resource policy
description: The function role had the required identity permission, but secret retrieval was denied only for one newly migrated credential. Other development secrets remained readable.
close_notes: Removed the incompatible resource-policy condition and retained the narrow role allowlist.
root_cause: A resource policy copied from a private workload required a specific network endpoint condition that the non-VPC Lambda could never satisfy.
resolution: Removed the incompatible endpoint condition, retained access for only the reviewed execution role, and added policy simulation to the migration checklist.

short_description: Voicebot loses verified account context after intent handoff
description: Verification succeeded, but the fulfillment turn asked the caller to verify again. Session storage contained the values under different field names than the fulfillment handler expected.
close_notes: Restored the stable session schema and verified cross-intent handoff.
root_cause: The verification handler serialized session attributes in camel case while the fulfillment handler read the established snake-case schema.
resolution: Restored the canonical attribute names, added schema-version compatibility mapping, and introduced an end-to-end verification-to-fulfillment dialog test.

short_description: Delayed voicebot turn overwrites newer conversation state
description: Callers occasionally returned to a prior question after responding quickly. Traces showed two overlapping turns writing the same session, with the slower earlier turn committing last.
close_notes: Prevented stale turn writes and confirmed ordered dialog progression.
root_cause: Session updates lacked an expected-version condition, allowing a delayed Lambda response to overwrite context written by a newer dialog turn.
resolution: Added optimistic version checks, discarded stale writes, serialized retries by session identifier, and tested deliberately reordered turn completion.

short_description: Long voicebot sessions stop persisting conversation state
description: Short conversations completed normally, while longer synthetic dialogs lost history after several turns. Persistence failures appeared only when accumulated diagnostic context became large.
close_notes: Bounded persisted context and verified long synthetic conversations.
root_cause: The session writer appended full turn diagnostics to the persisted item until it exceeded the storage service's item-size limit, then continued without saving state.
resolution: Stored only the bounded dialog state, moved diagnostics to short-lived telemetry, failed closed on persistence errors, and added maximum-length conversation tests.

short_description: Brazilian Portuguese callers enter generic language fallback
description: Language detection returned a supported regional locale, but the contact flow selected the generic fallback queue. Prompts were localized while agent routing was not.
close_notes: Preserved regional locale routing and verified Portuguese queue selection.
root_cause: A normalization step reduced the regional locale to its base language, but the routing table contained only the full regional key and therefore selected fallback.
resolution: Defined an explicit locale fallback hierarchy, preserved reviewed regional mappings, and added routing tests for full and base locale variants.

short_description: French contacts cannot find agents with the required language skill
description: The correct French queue received contacts, but routing reported no eligible agents despite available staff. Agent profiles showed a translated display label instead of the stable skill key.
close_notes: Restored stable skill keys and confirmed eligible-agent routing.
root_cause: The staffing import populated the localized skill display label where the routing profile required the stable language skill identifier.
resolution: Mapped imported profiles to stable skill identifiers, corrected affected synthetic agents, and added a validation that every localized queue has eligible staffing.

short_description: Italian contacts lose language selection after self-service
description: The initial menu selected Italian correctly, but contacts entered the English queue after returning from a self-service Lambda. The returned metadata contained the locale under a new field.
close_notes: Restored locale metadata continuity across the self-service branch.
root_cause: The self-service integration returned the selected locale as language while the downstream routing block read the established locale attribute.
resolution: Restored the canonical metadata field, added compatibility mapping at the integration boundary, and tested locale continuity through every self-service branch.

short_description: ServiceNow incident seed rejects reference display values
description: Synthetic incident creation returned a validation error when assignment and configuration-item fields were populated. The same request succeeded when those optional references were empty.
close_notes: Resolved references to sys_ids and retained empty values when no unique match existed.
root_cause: The loader sent human-readable reference names directly to fields configured to accept internal sys_ids, causing the Table API to reject the payload.
resolution: Added exact reference lookups, used only unique sys_ids, left unresolved optional references empty, and added tests preventing reference-record creation.

short_description: Repeated Analyze clicks exceed ServiceNow API usage rate
description: Operators received intermittent rate-limited responses when the form action was clicked more than once. API Gateway showed closely spaced duplicate requests for the same incident.
close_notes: Prevented duplicate submissions and confirmed requests remained within the usage plan.
root_cause: The UI Action remained enabled during the outbound REST call, allowing duplicate submissions that exceeded the development usage plan's request rate.
resolution: Disabled repeat submission while analysis is pending, retained safe rate-limit errors, and added a client-side correlation guard for the active request.

short_description: ServiceNow REST Message times out before analysis completes
description: Backend logs showed successful grounded analysis, but ServiceNow reported a transport timeout and did not write work notes. Longer investigations were affected while short ones completed.
close_notes: Aligned the REST timeout with the reviewed backend budget and verified work-note delivery.
root_cause: The scoped REST Message timeout remained below the observed retrieval-and-generation duration, so ServiceNow abandoned valid requests before the backend response arrived.
resolution: Set the protected timeout property within the reviewed backend budget, retained bounded transport handling, and tested both fast and long synthetic analyses.

short_description: Database pool capacity declines after handled request failures
description: Available connections decreased gradually even after traffic returned to normal. Pool metrics showed checked-out sessions with no active query following application exceptions.
close_notes: Closed leaked sessions and restored stable available-pool capacity.
root_cause: An exception handler recorded the database error but bypassed the connection-return block, leaking one checked-out session for each failed request.
resolution: Moved connection return into unconditional cleanup, added pool leak detection, and exercised transaction, timeout, and cancellation exception paths under load.

short_description: Open transactions occupy pool during downstream calls
description: Database CPU remained low while pool acquisition latency climbed. Traces showed transactions staying open while workers waited for an unrelated external response.
close_notes: Shortened transaction scope and recovered connection availability.
root_cause: The request handler opened a database transaction before calling a downstream service and held the pooled connection throughout that network wait.
resolution: Moved the downstream call outside the transaction, reduced transaction scope to the required writes, and alarmed on transaction age and pool wait time.

short_description: Serializable retry storm exhausts database connections
description: A contention burst produced serialization conflicts followed by a sharp rise in open sessions. Each retry acquired another connection before the previous attempt completed cleanup.
close_notes: Bounded serialization retries and restored connection-pool headroom.
root_cause: The serialization retry wrapper acquired a fresh pooled connection before releasing the failed attempt, multiplying connection demand during contention.
resolution: Released each failed transaction before retry, bounded attempts with jitter, reused the reviewed transaction helper, and load-tested conflict recovery.
